guard: donation layer of the money graph (test/money-guard.mjs): donor and party nodes without their contracts, grants and publicMoney totals, donor-to-party flows, and the meta rows describing them; the weekly public-money overlay is outside it. Re-pinned 2026-11-11 against the 2026-11-11 export: the AEC-only receipt rule (d786784a2) and the AEC associated-entity flag (export rule 9) changed the donation layer; each changed turn is reviewed in the PR. Re-pinned 2026-11-12 for additive recipient-side receipt types. Every pre-existing graph field and gold answer is unchanged; source_revision identifies that legacy data baseline. Receipt-types fix round 1 shares per-name exclusions with the uncapped report, removing six internal-party alias rows from typed cells only. Legacy gold rows remain unchanged. Re-pinned 2026-11-13 for the additive party-return cells (party return_by_type and return_by_type_year, meta.receipt_types.party_return_*): without them the layer hashes to the previous pin, party_receipts reads none of them, and every gold turn is unchanged. Typed-measure sweep 2026-11-13 (im/money-typed-sweep, 1ca526551): party_receipts reads each flow through its typed cells, so the gold rows now give what the parties' own returns list, each receipt once; donor-declared lines are no longer added and equal rows on a party return are kept as disclosed. That moves 14 gold turns; it does not change the donation layer or its fingerprint. Donation ranking 2026-11-13 (im/money-donation-rank, BACKLOG A34 and A35): every gold question asks who gives, gave or donates, so each turn now runs party_receipts with measure=donations and ranks AEC Donation Received only. The sources the old all-types gold ranked are kept as labelled other-receipt lines (other_receipts) and Public Funding as public_funding, never a donor row. Each changed turn says why in gold_change, from the typed AEC cells. The donation layer and its fingerprint are unchanged. Re-pinned 2026-11-13 for the Libertarian Party (im/ldp-money, export rule 10), on top of the donation ranking: one party node under its current name with the Liberal Democratic Party as an alias, its 15 federal donor flows (each typed from the party's own returns), those donors' totals, and the 250-donor cap that moves NIOA Nominees into the ranked donors, takes Linc Energy off the map and lets IT Alliance Australia on for its public money; and meta.receipt_types.selection in the donation-ranking exporter's wording (a Public Funding receipt under any other spelling stays its own public_funding cell), which main's committed graph had not yet carried. Every gold turn is re-checked against the live tool.
gold_method: partyDonations tool, measure=donations (AEC Donation Received), exact published selection, federal disclosed receipts; other receipt types as labelled lines; no inference of gifts, loans or influence
